data.adjudication: Investment acknowledged in written nomination answers; intent and legal significance unresolved.
data.claim: Howard Lutnick's written confirmation answers state that Cantor made a convertible debt investment in Tether's holding company in April 2024, after minority staff questioned an earlier statement that Cantor owned zero Tether. The record documents a disclosure dispute; it does not itself adjudicate an ethics violation.
